# Improvestu / FARU

> FARU (Find A Ride University) is a campus carpool message board for verified college students. Chat first, meet on campus, ride with classmates. Not a taxi or rideshare dispatch service.

## Product
- Name: FARU
- URL: https://www.improvestu.com/faru/
- Company: Shot Call'a Games, LLC (Improvestu initiative)
- Contact: improvestu@gmail.com

## Pricing
- Free: campus browse, up to 5 open ride posts, Ride Requests, chat, SOS/emergency contacts/check-ins, report/block, Events lists and post event ride, join clubs
- FARU+: 30-day free trial, then $4.99/mo or $49.99/yr — wider campus browse, unlimited posts, Quick Rides, Class Rides, After class, corridor alerts, For you, Events Near campus / For you, ad-free
- FARU Groups: $9.99/mo billed to the club — event ride hubs, club ride series; members still ride and ask for DD help for free
- FARU Groups Pro: $24.99/mo billed to the club — Groups plus officer roles, dashboard, reminders, templates, waitlist, duty, chapter report, multi DD, council

## Downloads
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.faru.faru
